name: Kugano Shizume
source:
Despite her appearance of a maid, she is actually a butler and right hand of Genichirou. A serious and hard worker, she is in charge of the rest of servants. 


[spoiler] She is the head of the Angel Committee that is dedicate to watching over demons. Its main purpose is to take action if the demon king ever returns [/spoiler]
